title: exact-exp32: correctly rounded single-precision exponentials, float-only exp2f on GPU, and a GPU genetic-programming search
description: Correctly rounded exp2f, expf, exp10f and logf without a rounding test on the CPU, a float-only correctly rounded exp2f on an NVIDIA GPU (RTX 5090), and a Koza-style genetic-programming search on the GPU for faster exact code. Every candidate is checked on all 2^32 inputs.
